name: Evil-M5Project
one_line: Wi-Fi pentest / evil-portal firmware with on-device UI for M5Stack Core2 (also AtomS3 and Fire): scanning, monitoring, karma and captive-portal attacks.
why_notable: 2623 stars, last commit 2026-09-06. The major M5Stack Wi-Fi firmware outside the Marauder/Ghost/Bruce family.

name: wardriver3000
one_line: Portable ESP32 + GPS + OLED + microSD wardriving device on a custom PCB with Wigle.net upload.

name: ESP32 Wardriver Pro
one_line: Passive-only ESP32 + GPS + OLED + SD wardriving logger writing WiGLE CSVs; explicitly does not deauth, join networks or inject.
why_notable: 40 stars, last commit 2026-05-18. Deliberately legal-safe design philosophy, a contrast to the active-attack tools.

name: WiFi Dev Board GPS Expansion
one_line: Solder-on adapter PCB that adds a microSD slot and GPS to the official (non-JCMK) Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board, plus UART activity LEDs, enabling Marauder's PCAP/wardriving storage on that board.
why_notable: Same borderline reasoning as the Dev Board Pro GPS Expansion: a capability-adding accessory for a board already in the DB (the official Flipper Zero Wi-Fi Dev Board), not a standalone device.
mcu: n/a (SD/GPS breakout, no MCU of its own)
has_ext_antenna: via GPS module (not detailed as SMA)
